title: Does CT-CLIP use a subpleural cyst-network topology index?
question: Conditional on adequate CT-RATE support and a validated latent intervention, does CT-CLIP's pulmonary-fibrotic-sequela score use information carried by a prespecified subpleural cyst-network topology index beyond generic scar burden, density, and emphysema directions?
deliverable_original: CT-CLIP is using honeycombing—the connected multilayer subpleural cyst network of end-stage fibrotic lung—rather than generic coarse lung texture.
deliverable_sentence: CT-CLIP's pulmonary-fibrotic-sequela score uses information carried by the prespecified subpleural cyst-network topology index, as linearly encoded in its representation, beyond generic scar burden, density, and emphysema directions.
claim_identity: The revised sentence does not establish that the index is honeycombing. Because the named X in the original deliverable has changed from a physician-level entity to an unvalidated computed index, this is a different deliverable under the 2026-08-10 claim-identity rule and should be registered as a successor rather than advanced as idea 019 in place.

claim_boundaries.claimed_only_if_all_gates_pass: Use of information along the frozen topology-index direction by ClassFine output 11 on the untouched test set.
not_claimed: That CT-CLIP has a pulmonary-fibrosis or UIP output.
That the model uses native honeycombing rather than every correlate carried by the validated direction.
That report honeycomb mentions validate X.
That the result generalizes beyond the inspected checkpoint and CT-RATE population.

rung.why: A gated latent intervention can test use of the computed index, but the index lacks independent construct validity as honeycombing and artifact exclusion is incomplete.
rung.move_up: Rung 1 requires K1, topology-encoding, G2a, and G2b to pass before locked test evaluation. Rung 2 requires exclusion or replication across scanner, vendor, protocol, reconstruction, site, positioning, habitus, prevalence, referral, and report leakage. Rung 3 requires an obtainable citable honeycombing quantifier with released weights and external validation against paraseptal emphysema and traction bronchiolectasis, or independent adjudicated construct validation followed by transport of frozen thresholds to CT-RATE.

X_measurement.X: Prespecified subpleural cyst-network topology index: threshold-persistent summaries of 3–10 mm wall-bounded air components, adjacency, stacking depth, pleural distance, Betti-1, and Euler characteristic.
X_measurement.how: Automatically segment the lungs, define a 15 mm subpleural shell, identify wall-bounded air components over frozen HU and wall-thickness thresholds, exclude components connected to the segmented airway tree, and compute the frozen graph and persistent-topology summary.
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes as a deterministic formula on an unseen scan. Whether it denotes honeycombing and survives routine CT-RATE acquisition and preprocessing remains uninspected.

keystone_prerequisite: On the obtainable CT-RATE evaluation data, there must be enough thin-slice topology-bearing fibrotic-sequela-positive cases, and the frozen topology index must be measurably encoded while an affine erasure of that encoding passes both native-manifold equivalence and case-matched sham-effect gates.
keystone_evidence: Official CT-CLIP code at commit a2a155c601987820433c01db69b64d701d3d229d was directly inspected: ClassFine index 11 is `Pulmonary fibrotic sequela`; preprocessing uses trilinear resampling to nominal 0.75 x 0.75 x 1.5 mm and center crop/pad. Those facts do not establish evaluation support, index encoding, construct validity, or intervention validity.
keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? Verifying the output name and preprocessing does not show that enough topology-bearing cases exist, that routine acquisition preserves the index, that CT-CLIP encodes it, or that erasure stays on-manifold and has an effect beyond sensitivity-matched shams. Those are the load-bearing assumptions.

stage_gates.K1_support_before_image_download: Freeze report regexes and partitions, then require at least 30 honeycomb-mentioning, RadBERT fibrotic-sequela-positive evaluation volumes, including at least 15 in the required thin-slice stratum. Report text is only a support gate, never X or construct validation. Failure ends the route as DATA_INSUFFICIENT.
stage_gates.K2_measurement_and_encoding: On validation data only, freeze the topology formula and require adequate repeatability from native volume to final model tensor plus prespecified out-of-sample encoding of the continuous index. This establishes preservation and encoding, not honeycombing denotation.
stage_gates.G2a_manifold_validity: After minimal-displacement affine erasure, projected validation embeddings must meet frozen k-nearest-neighbor-distance and density-equivalence margins relative to native validation embeddings.
stage_gates.G2b_case_matched_shams: For each validation case, compare the topology erasure with sham directions matched for embedding displacement and local ClassFine-head directional sensitivity. The topology effect must exceed the frozen sham-effect criterion.
stage_gates.test_lock: Use the untouched test set only if K1, K2, G2a, and G2b pass. Otherwise cancel confirmatory erasure and report only feasibility and explicitly exploratory association or reconstruction-pair results.

smallest_decisive_experiment.design: Run K1 without image download. If it passes, use validation data to freeze the topology index, nuisance directions, affine erasure, and K2/G2a/G2b thresholds. Only after every validation gate passes, estimate on the untouched test set whether topology-index erasure changes ClassFine index 11 more than the case-matched sham distribution and beyond separate scar-burden, density, and emphysema erasures.
smallest_decisive_experiment.primary_readout: Paired change in pulmonary-fibrotic-sequela score under topology-index erasure relative to the prespecified case-matched sham effect, with incremental comparison against the frozen nuisance erasures.
smallest_decisive_experiment.positive_interpretation: Conditional rung 1: the score uses information carried along the validated linear topology-index direction beyond the tested nuisance directions.
smallest_decisive_experiment.negative_interpretation: K1 failure decisively shows insufficient support for this route. G2a or G2b failure decisively invalidates this intervention but says nothing about model use. After all gates pass and power is adequate, an equivalently null topology effect with a positive-control nuisance effect meaningfully weakens linear use of this index; it does not exclude nonlinear use or honeycombing use.

use_vs_association: Score-index correlation and within-kernel-pair co-change are exploratory associations. Only the locked test result after K1/K2/G2a/G2b can support rung 1, and even then only for information carried by the linear index direction.
complementary_analysis: In geometry-matched same-acquisition reconstruction pairs from idea 004, test whether paired score changes track paired topology-index changes after measured noise and spectral band-power changes. This holds anatomy, site, referral, habitus, and positioning fixed but cannot separate wall topology from all reconstruction-induced high-frequency changes, so it is not the causal instrument.
dies_like_prior: It resembles idea 006 because an intervention may create inputs outside the classifier head's training distribution. It differs only if G2a and G2b directly validate the latent intervention; gate failure means it dies like idea 006 for rung-1 purposes. It inherits the annotation-provenance lesson from ideas 002 and 005: report language may gate support but cannot give the computed index the name honeycombing. The primary analysis itself does not require reader labels. It avoids idea 010's circularity because X is computed from voxel topology rather than from the output label or report.

closest_prior_work.citation: Hamamci IE et al., CT-CLIP / CT-RATE
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The directly inspected official code maps ClassFine output index 11 to `Pulmonary fibrotic sequela`.
closest_prior_work.delta: It does not test whether that output uses the proposed topology index.

closest_prior_work.citation: Sluimer I et al., Classification of Interstitial Lung Disease Patterns with Topological Texture Features
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The primary work used topological texture features for ILD-pattern classification.
closest_prior_work.delta: It classified image texture rather than testing reliance of a frozen report-supervised volumetric model.

closest_prior_work.citation: Lynch DA et al., Practical Imaging Interpretation in Patients Suspected of IPF
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The source defines honeycombing using contiguous subpleural cysts with complete walls and frequent multilayering and discusses emphysema as a mimic.
closest_prior_work.delta: A clinical definition does not validate the automated index on CT-RATE.

closest_prior_work.citation: Humphries SM et al., deep-learning CT analysis in IPF progression
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: This is a primary lead for automated honeycombing quantification; released-weight availability and validation suitability for the named mimics have not been inspected.
closest_prior_work.delta: It may supply future construct validation but does not establish CT-CLIP's use of the index.

novelty_statement: No novelty claim is made. Prior bounded searches found no direct test of CT-CLIP reliance on this topology index, but the gap is not exhaustively verified.

claim_identifiability.scanner_vendor_site_protocol_reconstruct: The same-acquisition pair analysis controls anatomy and many population factors but not generic reconstruction texture. Acquisition metadata and reconstruction strata are mandatory; single-site concentration prevents a rung-2 site claim.
claim_identifiability.positioning: An anatomy-relative pleural shell reduces coordinate dependence; paired reconstructions hold positioning fixed. Positioning remains a possible explanation in unpaired analyses.
claim_identifiability.body_habitus: Dose/noise and automatic body-size proxies enter nuisance analyses; residual habitus effects remain possible.
claim_identifiability.disease_prevalence_and_referral: K1 establishes support only. CT-RATE prevalence and referral pattern may shape encoding and limit transportability.
claim_identifiability.label_leakage: Reports and RadBERT labels are restricted to K1 support gating. X and the confirmatory paired score response are image-derived; report language cannot validate X.
remaining_alternatives: The frozen index mixes paraseptal emphysema, traction bronchiolectasis, and reconstruction-created wall closure.
The erased direction contains distributed scar severity despite the tested nuisance directions.
A passed local manifold test may not capture every way projected embeddings differ from the head's training distribution.

anticipated_negative.classification: mixed: decisive route-stopping negatives and a sensitivity-limited model-use null
anticipated_negative.meaningful_negative: K1 failure decisively establishes inadequate obtainable support. G2a/G2b failure decisively establishes that this erasure cannot identify use. If all gates and the minimum-detectable-effect requirement pass, an equivalently null topology effect with a functioning positive control weakens use of the linearly encoded index.
anticipated_negative.not_established: No negative result establishes that CT-CLIP does not use honeycombing or a nonlinear topology representation.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Persistent topology of a connected boundary-adjacent void network.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: Threshold-persistent component and loop counts, adjacency, wall completeness, multilayer depth, and pleural distance.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The experiment would use generic radiomics and would not specifically require threshold persistence, connectedness, or multilayer adjacency. The borrowed construct selects the exact measurable index; it does not supply the clinical name honeycombing.

data_and_compute.data: CT-RATE reports and labels for K1, followed only after K1 by an obtainable gated CT-RATE evaluation subset and geometry-matched reconstruction pairs already inventoried for idea 004.
data_and_compute.model: Official CT-CLIP ClassFine checkpoint, with output mapping, commit, and checksum pinned before inference.
data_and_compute.compute: Frozen-model inference, CPU topology measurements, and linear affine interventions fit within Colab Pro+ scale; no model training or annotation campaign is proposed.

mechanism_clarity.why: The suspected quantity is a frozen, deterministic topology index and the exact representation-level test is specified.

identifiability.why: G2a/G2b and nuisance erasures address major intervention alternatives, but construct validity and correlated nonlinear information remain unresolved.

interest.why: A scarring head using connected subpleural void topology is compelling, though less so without the physician-level honeycombing name.

medical_relevance.why: The endpoint is broad fibrotic sequela and the index lacks clinical construct validation, limiting direct ILD interpretation.

clarity.why: One conditional question tests use of one prespecified index by one verified output.

feasibility.why: Capped because the keystone is NOT_INSPECTED; K1 is cheap, but case support and intervention validity may fail.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped and based only on a bounded search; no novelty claim is made.

prior_legwork.why: The model code, checkpoint route, report gate, topology precedent, and reconstruction-pair inventory exist.

data_readiness.why: Reports permit the first gate, while images are gated and the qualifying support count is unknown.

evaluation_readiness.why: The gate families and controls are specified, but numeric margins, power, and sham construction require preregistration.

negative_result_value.why: Support or intervention-validity failures decisively stop the route, while a model-use null remains limited to the tested linear encoding.

regret.why: A cheap first gate can kill an unsupported story or justify a distinctive model-decoding experiment.

unverified_claims: K1 finds at least 30 honeycomb-mentioning fibrotic-sequela-positive evaluation volumes, including 15 thin-slice volumes.
The frozen topology index is preserved and encoded on obtainable CT-RATE images.
Minimal-displacement affine erasure passes G2a manifold-equivalence margins.
Topology erasure exceeds displacement- and local-sensitivity-matched sham effects.
An obtainable external quantifier or adjudicated resource can validate the index as honeycombing.
recommendation: SUPERSEDE idea 019 and register this index-level design as a new successor with parent_ids ["idea-019"]. If governance nevertheless permits revision in place, run K1 only; no image download, probe code, or model-use claim is authorized before a reviewed feasibility memo and probe contract.
